title: The harbour photograph
paragraphs: During the school holidays, Lina helped at her uncle’s small fishing shop beside the harbour. One quiet afternoon, she found a {{1}} photograph behind a shelf. It showed a wooden boat and a group of {{2}} men on the old pier.

Her uncle looked at the picture {{3}} for a long time. He explained that the boat had belonged to his father, who had {{4}} the shop many years before. Nobody in the family had seen the picture since a storm damaged the pier.

Lina wanted to learn more, so she asked the oldest fishermen for their {{5}}. Each of them remembered a different detail. One man {{6}} the name of the boat, and another pointed to the place where it had been tied. By the end of the week, Lina had written a short history of the pier. Her uncle put the photograph in a new frame and {{7}} it above the counter, where customers could see it. Several visitors stopped to talk about it, and the shop felt {{8}} than before.
